lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters distributed along the lateral flank, typically exhibiting 2-3 nodes per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-luminance circular blobs positioned at the intersections of vertical light-intensity bands and horizontal planes, creating a grid-like matrix.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features along the upper flank defined by a sharp light-to-dark pixel gradient transition on the vertical axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density arrangement of small high-luminance nodes localized on the remaining basal portion of the primary dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Truncated first dorsal fin showing evidence of major distal amputation, leaving an irregular and flattened superior margin. Secondary notches are visible on the trailing edge of the inferior pelvic fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A non-biological white graphical arrow is superimposed on the image, oriented towards the truncated dorsal fin margin.
